maintenance.title: We’ll be right back
maintenance.body: Covenant Path is briefly down for maintenance. Please check back in a little while.
maintenance.ownerBannerOn: Maintenance mode is ON — only you can see the app.
maintenance.cardHelp: When ON, everyone except you sees a maintenance screen and the database returns no member data to them — flip it the moment anything looks wrong, then turn it back off once it’s fixed.

settings.languageHelp: Choose the language used across the app.

fillData.title: Fill missing data
fillData.intro: Some profile fields can’t be pulled by the automatic daily sync — the Church website only shares them during a brief signed-in session. A quick re-authorization fills them for the whole stake.
fillData.cellHint: Not available — click to see how to fill it
fillData.membersWithGaps: Members with at least one missing field: {{count}}
fillData.done: Done — {{filled}} of {{total}} members updated. Refreshing the table…
fillData.failed: The fill didn’t finish. Try again, or re-authorize and retry.
fillData.needsReauth: Your stored Church session has expired, so the data must be filled during a fresh sign-in. Re-authorize to continue — the fill starts automatically afterwards.
fillData.notLeader: These fields need a stake leader: filling them takes a quick re-authorization with a stake leader’s Church account. Ask your stake leadership to open this panel and tap “Fill missing data now”.
fillData.noAccess: The account enrolled for sync doesn’t have access to member profiles in LCR, so these fields can’t be refreshed. A stake leader whose calling grants “Member Profiles” should enroll for sync.
fillData.allFilled: Every profile field is filled — nothing to do.
fillData.statusError: Couldn’t load the data status — close and try again.
